multipliers.name: Global Multiplier
multipliers.behavior: The global multiplier is only affected by a Multiplier Treasure Target being shot at by the Pirate’s Cannons. The increase of the multiplier is independent of the size of the Multiplier Treasure Target, and takes place prior to the payout. The global multiplier is persistent and never decreases during an ongoing game round.
